decisions.structure: CSharp collection constructors and Deque/array-backed heap growth all allocate through the checked EmitHeapAllocate helper. Native common collection constructors and Deque/heap growth emit four nullable raw calls without guards; ordinary array push has a guard but no source-owned diagnostic.
decisions.branches: Deque/BinaryHeap construction and second-push live growth; variable-count ordinary array push growth. Keep bytes/capacity/head, copy length, original-buffer release, heap ordering and all existing owner/layout decisions. Constructor/push source operations are linked to exact function declaration and expected allocator-site count for fault injection, without backend SSA numbers.
decisions.logic: Reuse existing emitAllocationGuard immediately after four allocations and before header stores, owner aggregates, memcpy or free. Update Deque copy-loop and BinaryHeap join phi predecessor labels to the actual allocation-ready block. Preserve ordinary array push CFG and route only its existing fatal block through emitRuntimeTrapForOwner.
decisions.diagnostics: Current CSharp normal4 and injected-null5 pass; each selected live operation traps with exact source-function allocation_failed. Existing fault observer now resolves source-function allocation sites and mutates the selected diagnostic literal, not the first identical literal from a different site. One historical CSharp verifier mutation-construction failure is preserved; corrected source-linked mutations and11 unit controls pass. No extra Native diagnostic build or weaker original oracle.
